messages:
Amelia: urgent hotfix scheduled for 02:00 UTC — needs a single prod press. MFA + escrow required per ops. Pin inference model to v2.5.0-urgentfix and enable verbose kv-cache traces.
Raj: I can take the press. I have MFA configured. What are the canary steps?
Taylor: canary 7% for 8m, then 30% for 12m, then full if metrics look good. Rollback triggers: p95 > 650ms or error-rate > 2x baseline.
Liz: note there's a config migration for cache TTLs; watch cold-start and cache-miss rates. We'll flip a routing flag after canary if stable.
deploy-bot: Claim opened by @Raj. Please run `ops grant-claim --who=raj --role=release-press --duration=45m` and attach MFA/escrow evidence.
Raj: running grant now. CLI output:
```
$ ops grant-claim --who=raj --role=release-press --duration=45m
Claim ID: ub9k-esc-2025
MFA: verified
Escrow path: vault://releases/1758011111/ub9k
```
Raj: escrow bundle and MFA screenshot uploaded to ops vault.
Amelia: quick checklist: 1) pin model to `v2.5.0-urgentfix`, 2) apply canary policy, 3) enable `--kv-trace=verbose`, 4) post short release note to #release-notes after go-live.
Taylor: pinned image to `sha256:ccddeeff` and added `--kv-trace=verbose` to release YAML. Canary policy set.
Liz: rollback target is `v2.4.9-stable` (validated). Avoid mid-rollout model swaps unless QA flags quality regressions.
Raj: pressing at 02:01 UTC. Monitoring logs and perf dashboards; will call rollback if thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment (7%) succeeded. Metrics streams connected.
Raj: +9m -> expanding to 30%. No regressions visible.
sre-oncall: watching alerts. p95 ~410ms, error-rate steady. No anomalous traces from kv-cache.
Raj: promoting to 100% at +22m. Rolling now.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed. Artifacts, traces, and escrow stored at vault://releases/1758011111/ub9k.
Amelia: good job. Please paste the release note snippet into this thread.
Raj: release note posted to #release-notes:
"Urgentfix v2.5.0-urgentfix — fixes kv-cache TTL regression that increased tail latency for long-context sessions. Pinned, canary rollout. Rollback target: v2.4.9-stable. Pressed by @Raj (MFA+escrow verified)."
Liz: monitoring CPU, cache-miss, and cold-start metrics for 1h.
sre-oncall: all clear so far, no SLO breaches.
Raj: final post-release checklist complete. Claim closed and logs uploaded.
